answer: An hostile operator therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The falcon counter is kept in vertex and mesa publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 383 aliases cost 112 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
